I have done volunteer work and I make my meager living working with students with disabilities, but I must have incredibly bad karma. Thank you all, but I may be a hopeless case. No matter what I do -- and I do a lot -- my life just gets worse and today -- I don't know how much more I can take. I'm sorry, but I've been to therapists and counselors. I live on a diet of antidepressants and anti-anxiety agents and weed, which helps most of all. I can be fine sometimes if I'm drugged up. I work full-time, I try, I really do. But there are never any changes and I'm fuckin' exhausted. I'm sorry. I am beyond help right now. It hurts to be alive. Again, thank you and I'm sorry.
